FAQ
Got Questions?
We Got Answers.
How much does a repair cost? ▼
Repairs start at $18.99. The final price depends on your device model and repair type. We always confirm the exact price before any work begins — zero surprises.
How long does a repair take? ▼
Most repairs — including iPhone screen replacements — are done on-site in about 20 minutes. More complex issues like water damage may take longer, but we keep you updated throughout.
My phone got wet — what do I do? ▼
Contact us immediately. Do NOT charge it or turn it on. The faster we act, the better the chance of saving your device.
What areas do you serve? ▼
All of Michiana — South Bend, Mishawaka, Granger, Elkhart, Niles MI, Notre Dame, and surrounding areas. Not nearby? Just ask!
Do repairs come with a warranty? ▼
Yes. We stand behind our work. If something isn't right after your repair, contact us and we'll make it right. Our reputation depends on it.
